# SpoolPilot

> A native iPhone app that shows Etsy sellers their real, per-order profit on 3D-printed
> products — syncing the exact fees Etsy charged and subtracting the true cost of goods.

SpoolPilot is made for people who run a 3D-printing shop on Etsy. It answers one question that
filament trackers and spreadsheets don't: **what did this order actually make me, after Etsy's
fees and what it cost to print?** It is published by Opus Design Group LLC and built by a working
Etsy seller with 3,000+ sales.

## What it does (shipping today)

- **Real Etsy fees, not estimates.** Connects to Etsy (read-only) and reads the exact fees Etsy
  charged on each order from Etsy's own ledger — transaction, payment processing, listing, and
  Offsite Ads — then subtracts them to the cent to show net profit per order.
- **True cost of goods.** Subtracts filament (by grams and $/kg), print electricity, packaging,
  and labor, so profit reflects the whole cost, not just the sale price.
- **Slicer scan.** The camera reads print time and grams from Bambu Studio, OrcaSlicer, and
  PrusaSlicer screens, then prices the print (fees and labor included).
- **Filament inventory.** Sealed spools counted by barcode scan — no weighing — with a weeks-of-
  stock forecast from real sales pace.
- **Smart "print next" queue.** Ranks what to print by how soon each product runs out, using the
  shop's own sales velocity.
- **Full profit-and-loss.** Revenue, cost of materials, operating expenses, and net profit for any
  month or all-time — no spreadsheet.
- **A pricing calculator** that can *estimate* fees and suggest a list price for a print not yet
  sold. Estimates are always marked as estimates (a leading "~").

## What it is not

- Not a web dashboard — it is a native iOS (iPhone) app.
- Not a general manufacturing-inventory suite. It is focused on Etsy 3D-print shops and per-order
  profit, deliberately narrower than tools like Craftybase.
- Not an all-marketplace connector today — sales sync currently supports Etsy.

## Privacy

Data lives on the user's iPhone and their own iCloud. There is no account, nothing is uploaded to
the developer, and **the app contains no analytics or tracking SDKs**. The Etsy connection is
read-only and reads only the seller's own shop numbers — never buyers' personal details.

The marketing website (spoolpilot.app) does use analytics to count visits. It never receives
anything from the app; the two are unconnected. See https://spoolpilot.app/privacy.html

## Pricing

Free to download; Pro is $12.99/month or $99.99/year with a 7-day trial on the yearly plan.
Pro adds unlimited sales sync, the full P&L, and stock forecasts. Core inventory, the pricing
calculator, and manual tracking stay free.

## Platform and status

- Platform: iOS (iPhone), native.
- Status: live on the App Store, free to download (app id 6796133961). Version 1.1 is in
  review as of 2026-09-04.
- Languages: English, Spanish, German.
- Publisher: Opus Design Group LLC.
